import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os
import re

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from correct paths
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/en_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/en_test_2.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Split training data into train and validation (hold-out)
# Validation set will NEVER be used to build mappings
train_split, val_split = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["class"]
)
print(f"Training split: {len(train_split)}, Validation split: {len(val_split)}")

# Build class-specific mappings from TRAINING DATA ONLY (not validation)
class_mappings = {}
for class_name in train_split["class"].unique():
    class_data = train_split[train_split["class"] == class_name]
    mapping = (
        class_data.groupby("before")["after"]
        .agg(lambda x: x.mode()[0] if len(x.mode()) > 0 else x.iloc[0])
        .to_dict()
    )
    class_mappings[class_name] = mapping

print(f"Built mappings for {len(class_mappings)} classes")


def predict_class(before_text):
    """Improved heuristic to predict class based on text"""
    before_text = str(before_text).strip()
    before_lower = before_text.lower()

    # Punctuation check
    if len(before_text) == 1 and before_text in ".,!?;:'\"()[]{}":
        return "PUNCT"

    # Time check (contains colon with digits)
    if ":" in before_text and any(c.isdigit() for c in before_text):
        return "TIME"

    # Date check (contains / or - with digits)
    if any(x in before_text for x in ["/", "-"]) and any(
        c.isdigit() for c in before_text
    ):
        return "DATE"

    # Money check
    if any(x in before_text for x in ["$", "£", "€", "USD", "GBP", "EUR"]):
        return "MONEY"

    # Measure check
    if any(
        unit in before_lower
        for unit in ["ft", "lb", "m", "kg", "cm", "in", "meter", "pound", "foot"]
    ):
        return "MEASURE"

    # Percent check
    if "%" in before_text:
        return "PERCENT"

    # Cardinal/number check (contains digits)
    if re.match(r"^[\d\.,\-]+$", before_text) and any(c.isdigit() for c in before_text):
        return "CARDINAL"

    # Fraction check
    if "/" in before_text and all(c.isdigit() or c == "/" for c in before_text):
        return "CARDINAL"

    # Default to PLAIN
    return "PLAIN"


def normalize_token(before_text, class_name=None, mappings=None):
    """Normalize a single token using class-specific mappings"""
    before_text = str(before_text).strip()
    if class_name is None:
        class_name = predict_class(before_text)
    if mappings is None:
        mappings = class_mappings
    if class_name in mappings and before_text in mappings[class_name]:
        return mappings[class_name][before_text]
    return before_text


# VALIDATION: Compute accuracy on hold-out set (model NEVER saw this data)
val_split["predicted_after"] = val_split.apply(
    lambda row: normalize_token(row["before"], row["class"]), axis=1
)
accuracy_true_class = (val_split["predicted_after"] == val_split["after"]).mean()
print(f"Validation Accuracy (using true class): {accuracy_true_class:.4f}")

# Also test with predicted class (more realistic for test set)
val_split["predicted_class"] = val_split["before"].apply(predict_class)
val_split["predicted_after_pred_class"] = val_split.apply(
    lambda row: normalize_token(row["before"], row["predicted_class"]), axis=1
)
accuracy_predicted_class = (
    val_split["predicted_after_pred_class"] == val_split["after"]
).mean()
print(f"Validation Accuracy (using predicted class): {accuracy_predicted_class:.4f}")

# Make predictions for test set
test_df["predicted_after"] = test_df["before"].apply(lambda x: normalize_token(x, None))

# Create submission file with correct format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str)
        + "_"
        + test_df["token_id"].astype(str),
        "after": test_df["predicted_after"],
    }
)

# Verify submission format matches sample
expected_cols = ["id", "after"]
if list(submission_df.columns) != expected_cols:
    submission_df = submission_df[expected_cols]

# Save submission to correct path
submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\nSubmission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Total predictions: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"Unique IDs in submission: {submission_df['id'].nunique()}")

# Verify submission file
if os.path.exists("submission/submission.csv"):
    print("✓ Submission file created successfully!")
    submission_check = pd.read_csv("submission/submission.csv")
    print(f"✓ File readable with {len(submission_check)} rows")

    # Check format matches sample submission
    if list(submission_check.columns) == expected_cols:
        print(f"✓ Column format matches sample submission")
    else:
        print(
            f"✗ Column format mismatch: {list(submission_check.columns)} vs {expected_cols}"
        )
else:
    print("✗ Submission file NOT created!")

# Print final validation accuracy (this is the genuine hold-out estimate)
print(f"\n=== FINAL VALIDATION METRIC ===")
print(f"Accuracy (using predicted class): {accuracy_predicted_class:.4f}")
